package.pdf_converter: MinerU optional for PDF; not required for Markdown or text

native_strengths: never add facts, empirical claims, citations, or data
preserve equations, citation keys, variables, numbers, propositions, and footnotes
do not quote or paraphrase corpus-paper content during style extraction
human confirmation gate before manuscript revision
external writing skills are optional and are not downloaded automatically
scope_blockers: mandatory Phase 1 output is a dynamic writing skill and journal style profile
primary input is a target-journal corpus and writing destination
Phase 2 scores journal match and labels issues by acceptance severity
the workflow optimizes publication fit rather than producing a neutral evidence-bounded manuscript
no standalone revision mode bypasses journal-style generation
additional_risks: journal norms inferred from small corpora are not statistically calibrated
hard verbatim preservation can retain an incorrect citation or technical statement
outputs are written beside the manuscript unless the workflow is modified
